"Literature Review: Survey existing literature on threshold signature schemes to understand the current state of the art."
Treatment in the Report: The literature review consists of a recapitulation of the relevant security & efficiency properties of threshold (ECDSA) signature schemes, with a discussion on their relevance for the integration in Atala Prism (Section 2). A summary of the current state-of-the-art threshold ECDSA signature schemes suitable for this project is given in Section 3 and the systematic comparison w.r.t. to the earlier established properties in Section 3.1. And finally, we discuss our choice for the scheme by Canetti et al. (Section 3.2). For a more in-depth, general literature review on threshold ECDSA schemes, we refer the reader to the paper by Aumasson et al. “A Survey of ECDSA Threshold Signing” published in 2020.
"Security Analysis: Analyze various threshold signature schemes for their security strengths and weaknesses."
Treatment in the Report: Is covered in the summary of the schemes (Section 3), where we mention the security properties or the proof model and highlight the crucial points in Table 1. In Section 3.2 we explicitly discuss the crucial points of the different security properties of the schemes and their implications for the integration task.
